title: Planetary floral kingdom roster
scope: Six-kingdom planetary producer-and-decomposer roster at growth-strategy-theme level. Kingdom names, in-world taxonomy, energy capture, chemistry, anatomy, reproduction, dispersal, Mana patterns, local presence, minor kingdoms, and assignments of referenced vegetation remain open.
approval_evidence: After the A/B/C floral-roster options were presented with A recommended, the Author selected 'A — Six kingdoms' on 2026-08-17.
question: Should the planet's producer and decomposer life get a kingdom roster parallel to the faunal lineage roster, and at what grain?
selection: Adopt the six-kingdom roster: K1 networked modular flora (home of the reserve-web guild); K2 tower flora (long-lived self-supporting woody-analogue structures); K3 free-seeder flora (short-lived unnetworked fast-dispersing plants); K4 water flora (submerged, floating, and wet-margin producers); K5 crust-and-cushion flora (low surface-hugging pioneers); K6 thread decomposers (non-photosynthesising thread-and-body networks). Every kingdom includes abundant ordinary forms.
alternatives: FLORA-ROSTER-B: three-group minimal frame of networked producers, free-living producers, and decomposers; not selected.
FLORA-ROSTER-C: no roster, guild-by-guild development; not selected.
rationale: The six-kingdom roster mirrors the structure just accepted for fauna, gives the reserve-web guild a kingdom home without changing its records, provides candidate slots for every referenced-but-undeveloped vegetation class, and adds the decomposer kingdom the open food-web work needs, while binding only one-line growth-strategy themes.
consequences: The planet's macroscopic producer and decomposer life is organised across six kingdoms at growth-strategy-theme level.
The reserve-web guild belongs to the networked-modular kingdom with its existing records unchanged.
The rainforest, woodland, wet-margin, and egg-substrate vegetation gain candidate kingdom homes pending their own records.
Decomposer and mutualist design gains a dedicated kingdom slot.
Later flora development must proceed through bounded proposals against these kingdom slots.
No System mechanic, guaranteed harvest, spawn source, or Earth transplant is created.
residual_unknowns: Kingdom names and all in-world taxonomies remain open.
Energy capture, chemistry, anatomy, reproduction, dispersal, seasonality, and Mana patterns per kingdom remain open except where existing records govern.
Kingdom assignments for the rainforest, woodland, wet-margin, and egg-substrate vegetation remain open.
Minor or relict kingdoms below the roster's grain remain possible through their own records.
Microscopic producer and decomposer life remains open.
Human uses, domesticates, and crops remain open.
reopening_conditions: A needed producer or decomposer strategy cannot plausibly fit any kingdom.
Kingdom-first design proves too coarse or too restrictive for story needs.
A concrete contradiction with an accepted or provisional record emerges.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
